metadata.framework: VEGA-MITI Swarm Stress Test & Reliability Audit

tests.name: six_heterogeneous_agents_initialization
tests.details: Verified 6 agents with types UAV, USV, RELAY, UGV and distinct capabilities.

tests.name: mission_priority_ordering
tests.details: Priority 1 allocated before Priority 3: True

tests.name: simultaneous_mission_allocation_no_conflicts
tests.details: Allocated 5 simultaneous missions to 5 distinct agents without duplicate assignment.

tests.name: astar_obstacle_avoidance_pathfinding
tests.details: A* generated valid collision-free path circumventing obstacle barrier: True

tests.name: mission_lifecycle_and_battery_drain
tests.details: Battery drained from 95.0% to 94.5%, mission completed, agent returned to AVAILABLE.

tests.name: uav_failure_and_takeover
tests.details: Failed UAV (DRONE_AERIAL_1) triggered reassignment to replacement UAV (RELAY_NODE_1).

tests.name: usv_failure_and_takeover
tests.details: Failed USV (USV_RIVER_1) triggered takeover by secondary USV (USV_RIVER_2).

tests.name: ugv_failure_and_takeover
tests.details: Failed UGV (GROUND_SCOUT_1) triggered reassignment to capable backup agent (DRONE_AERIAL_2).

tests.name: failed_agent_execution_halt
tests.details: Failed agent remained stationary at (1, 1) without executing mission steps while disconnected.

tests.name: agent_reconnection_and_event_sync
tests.details: Reconnected DRONE_AERIAL_1, synchronized buffered events, recorded NETWORK_RECONNECTED.

tests.name: simultaneous_22_station_critical_activation
tests.details: Generated 44 unique missions for 22 simultaneous CRITICAL stations.

tests.name: repeated_activation_and_stepping_25_cycles
tests.details: Completed 25 repeated activation/allocation/step cycles without exceptions.

tests.name: rapid_risk_level_transitions
tests.details: Cycled through NORMAL->WATCH->WARNING->CRITICAL->NORMAL 10 times without state degradation.

tests.name: mission_queue_oversubscription_handling
tests.details: Handled 30 missions for 6 agents: 3 assigned, 27 queued as PENDING safely.

tests.name: mass_agent_disconnection_handling
tests.details: All 6 agents disconnected; allocation returned empty list safely without crashes.

tests.name: empty_mission_queue_operations
tests.details: Allocations, simulation steps, and lease timeouts executed cleanly on empty queues.

tests.name: out_of_bounds_target_safety
tests.details: Out-of-bounds target (999, 999) handled gracefully without infinite loop or crash.

tests.name: yamuna_12_step_count_verification
tests.details: Yamuna 2023 replay contains exactly 12 frames (expected 12).

tests.name: yamuna_provenance_and_peak_discharge_distinction
tests.details: Hathnikund peak release 359,000 cfs logged on 2023-07-11; all-time peak crest 208.66m on 2023-07-13; local in-situ discharge strictly UNMETERED_IN_SITU.

tests.name: susquehanna_13_step_count_verification
tests.details: Susquehanna 2023 replay contains exactly 13 frames (expected 13).

tests.name: susquehanna_peak_crest_and_risk_progression
tests.details: Peak flow 179,000 cfs on 2023-12-20 correctly categorized as CRITICAL.

tests.name: historical_replay_live_swarm_isolation
tests.details: Live swarm coordinator state remained strictly isolated and invariant across replay executions.

tests.name: replay_execution_idempotency
tests.details: Repeated replay execution produced identical deterministic observation frames.

tests.name: burst_request_stability_30_calls
tests.details: Executed 30 consecutive status requests with 100% success rate (mean 10.33 ms).
